physical.title: One native ray in a finite rectangular mirror box

interpretation.requestedResult: Verify one native reflection per finite wall and actual absorption at the target for the given launch.
stated: A04 asks for launch and reverse directions between two interior points with one reflection from each wall.
derived: This independent numeric control launches along the unfolded displacement (-455,-440).
assumptions: The dimensions, endpoints, corner gaps and finite absorbing target are explicitly chosen for this numeric control.
unknowns: The original A04 rectangle dimensions and point coordinates.
